Key Considerations:
• Monitoring the execution of the 2020 – 2024 strategy including business plans and budgets and advising on,
reviewing and approving any changes to the plan.
• Reviewing market updates and recommending actions for implementation against the Group’s strategic
plans.
• Considering updates and advising on the Group’s digital strategy.
• Reviewing, advising on and approving significant matters with a bearing on the Group’s capital structure
and position.
• Considering and recommending for Shareholder approval the Group’s dividend payment proposal.
• Considering and prioritising investment opportunities and determining optimal resource allocation.
• Reviewing and approving the Annual Report.
• Group Business sustainability review.
• Reviewing and approving the Group’s Annual Budget.
• Considering matters affecting Human Capital and People Management including performance
management and reward frameworks.

• Monitoring and reviewing updates of the Company’s and its subsidiaries’ financial performance against the
set business budgets and strategies and providing guidance on improvements.
• Reviewing the Company’s and subsidiaries’ Operating Plan assumptions against the actual achievement of
objectives for adjustment of budgets and resources towards achieving the performance targets.
• Assessing financial forecasts against actual performance and reviewing business models and assumptions
as a result.
• Evaluating operational metrics to enhance effectiveness, efficiency and alignment with the strategic
objectives.
• Undertaking performance benchmarking against industry peers and other select organisations in view of the
Group’s aspirational goals.
• Considering and approving the Group’s financial reports (including the Directors’ Remuneration Report) and
the accounting policies in use and issuing a Directors’ Report thereof.
• Establishing annual objectives for the measurement of the specific performance of the subsidiaries and
consolidated performance of the Group.
